categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Touches the CMake build system configuration to forward hardening flags to the secp256k1 subtree, carrying the 'Build system' label.
categories.rationale: Missing hardening flags in embedded secp256k1 cause linkers to drop binary-wide control-flow integrity protections from the compiled executable. As noted in the PR description, 'the three secp256k1 objects are the only ones in the build tree without it' on Ubuntu 26.04 AArch64, stripping BTI and PAC markers from bitcoind.
